<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10b:3">Ab. Zar. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>הוה שדר ליה … במ׳ וכ׳</he> (Rashi in early eds. <cite ref="M00962"><he>מַטָּארָאתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="M00962"><he>מַטָּארָתָא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80) he sent him gold dust in bags and wheat on top.
<cite ref="Ketubot 110a:9">Keth. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>הפוכי מ׳ למה לי</he> why change bags (of equal weight from one side of the animal to the other)?, i.e. let the two accounts balance each other.
